_comment: Initial source registry. Loaded into the `sources` table on first run (INSERT OR IGNORE); afterwards the database is the source of truth and rows can be edited/disabled without code changes. Every feed_url was fetched with the CrucixBorderWatch User-Agent on the discovery_date and returned HTTP 200 with the stated feed_type, except where notes say otherwise. content_policy=full fetches article pages (robots permitting) and stores raw HTML + text; content_policy=metadata_only is set where the publisher's terms of use prohibit robots/scraping of the site: only the syndication feed / news sitemap the publisher advertises is read and article pages are never requested.

sources.notes: Nexstar Media border desk. Nexstar Terms of Use prohibit robots/spiders and scraping of its properties; only the RSS feed the site advertises in robots.txt is consumed (headline, summary, URL, timestamps). Article pages are not fetched. Full-text access would require a Nexstar license.

sources.discovery_method: Google News sitemap; robots.txt disallows /feeds/ for all agents, so RSS is not used
sources.notes: Gannett; metered paywall. Paywalled items are stored headline/summary/URL only. The site's edge returns HTTP 403 to clients that do not accept compressed responses; the crawler advertises gzip/deflate like any standard HTTP client. If robots.txt still answers 403 the poller records robots_blocked and skips the source rather than working around it.
Nonprofit newsroom, Creative Commons republishing guidelines.

sources.discovery_method: sitemap index -> news sitemap; no RSS endpoint found
sources.notes: ABC affiliate, Weslaco TX. KRGV terms permit crawlers only for public search-engine indexing, not for capturing or archiving material; the news sitemap is read for headline/URL/timestamp only and article pages are not fetched.
Nexstar Media (KVEO/KGBT). Nexstar Terms of Use prohibit robots/spiders and scraping; feed metadata only, article pages are not fetched.

sources.discovery_method: sitemap_news.xml index -> local news sitemap; no RSS endpoint found
sources.notes: Hearst; metered paywall. Hearst Newspapers Terms of Use prohibit robots/crawlers/scraping and aggregation; the news sitemap is read for headline/URL/timestamp only and article pages are not fetched. Licensing: https://info.wrightsmedia.com/hearst-newspapers-licensing-and-reprints

sources.discovery_method: sitemap_news.xml index -> local news sitemap; no RSS endpoint found
sources.notes: Hearst; hard/metered paywall. Same Hearst terms as Laredo Morning Times; metadata only, article pages are not fetched.

sources.discovery_method: Public WordPress REST API (preferred over scraping); returns full content, categories and entity-typed tags
sources.notes: API carries full article HTML, so article pages are not fetched. Republishing allowed under CC BY-NC-ND.
Fallback only; disabled while the WP REST API source is healthy.
Regional daily, Tamaulipas. Aviso legal prohibits redistribution/reproduction of content (no crawler clause; robots.txt allows /). Text is stored for internal analysis only and is never republished.
Independent investigative weekly, Baja California. Site publishes only a privacy notice (no terms of use); robots.txt allows /feed/.
National news weekly; metered paywall. Aviso legal prohibits reproduction of content (no crawler clause; robots.txt allows /). Text is stored for internal analysis only and is never republished.

sources.discovery_method: robots.txt Sitemap: directive (Google News sitemap index); /feed/, /rss7/, /rss10/ are disallowed for all agents and no RSS endpoint exists
sources.notes: Aviso legal restricts obtaining content to the means the site establishes and bans reproduction; only the robots-advertised news sitemap is read (headline/URL/timestamp) and article pages are not fetched. The site's edge WAF has returned HTTP 403 to some client stacks; when robots.txt is unavailable the poller records robots_blocked and does not work around it.

Compiles unverified citizen reporting on cartel activity, mostly translated from Spanish sources. Treat as unverified. Hosted on Blogger (Google Terms of Service apply; no site-specific terms); robots.txt allows the Atom feed.

sources.discovery_method: Public WordPress REST API filtered to the Mexico post tag (id 549, verified via /wp-json/wp/v2/tags/549)
sources.notes: Organized-crime research outlet. No site terms of use published (privacy policy only); robots.txt has no active rules. Articles are polled with the news pipeline; group/personality profiles are loaded weekly by the insight_crime baseline loader.

sources.outlet_name: Justice in Mexico (University of San Diego)
sources.notes: Research program news feed. No site terms of use published (privacy policy only). Annual Organized Crime and Violence in Mexico report editions are tracked by the justice_in_mexico_ocvm baseline loader.
